ClientName.title: Spektrix System Name
ClientName.description: The tenant's Spektrix system name (the client identifier Spektrix assigns to the organisation). Tenant-specific; supplied per company, never baked into the connector.

ApiLoginName.title: API Login Name
ApiLoginName.description: The Spektrix API login name issued for the tenant's API user. Used as the identity in the SpektrixAPI3 request signature.

ApiSecretKey.title: API Secret Key
ApiSecretKey.description: Base-64 encoded API secret key issued with the API login. Decoded and used as the HMAC-SHA1 signing key for each request.

BaseURL.title: Base URL Override
BaseURL.description: Optional full v3 API root override for custom domains or non-standard deployments. Leave blank to use the default Spektrix v3 endpoint for the system name.
